mwassistant-desc: Short description of the MW Assistant extension shown on Special:Version.
mwassistant: Display name of the [[Special:MWAssistant]] page in the special-pages listing.
mwassistant-summary: One-sentence description shown under the special-page link in [[Special:SpecialPages]].
mwassistant-chat-title: Heading shown above the chat UI on Special:MWAssistant.
mwassistantembeddings: Display name of the [[Special:MWAssistantEmbeddings]] page in the special-pages listing.
mwassistantembeddings-summary: One-sentence description shown under the special-page link in [[Special:SpecialPages]].
mwassistantembeddings-pagetitle: Page title rendered at the top of [[Special:MWAssistantEmbeddings]].
mwassistantstream: Internal name for the SSE streaming endpoint Special:MWAssistantStream. The page is unlisted, so this is mostly seen in URLs and logs.
right-mwassistant-use: Permission label for the 'mwassistant-use' user right (shown in [[Special:ListGroupRights]]).
action-mwassistant-use: Action label used in log entries when a user invokes MWAssistant features.
apierror-mwassistant-invalid-jwt: API error returned when an MWAssistant request carries an invalid or expired JWT.
specialpages-group-labki: Heading for the Labki group on [[Special:SpecialPages]] (shared with sister extensions like SemanticSchemas).
mwassistant-search-icon-title: Tooltip shown when hovering over the MW Assistant shortcut icon next to the search input.
mwassistant-search-icon-label: Accessible label (aria-label) for the MW Assistant shortcut icon next to the search input.
mwassistantembeddings-batch-queued: Transient success notice shown immediately after a batch enqueue. $1 = number of jobs enqueued, $2 = number of pages skipped because already in sync.
mwassistantembeddings-batch-nothing-to-d: Notice shown when a batch enqueue had no work to do. $1 = number of pages already in sync.
mwassistantembeddings-single-queued: Notice shown after a successful single-page embedding enqueue. $1 = page title.
mwassistantembeddings-jobs-pending: Persistent banner shown on every page render while embedding jobs are still in the queue. $1 = total pending count (waiting + currently running).
mwassistantembeddings-reload-hint: Trailing instruction in the pending-jobs banner pointing the user at the reload control.
mwassistant-chat-new: Label of the button that starts a new conversation, and heading shown for a conversation that has no title yet.
mwassistant-chat-loading-sessions: Placeholder shown in the conversation list while it loads.
mwassistant-chat-sessions-error: Shown in the conversation list when it could not be loaded.
mwassistant-chat-sessions-empty: Shown in the conversation list when the user has no saved conversations.
mwassistant-chat-session-untitled: Fallback title for a saved conversation that has no title.
mwassistant-chat-session-delete: Tooltip and accessible label of the button that deletes a saved conversation.
mwassistant-chat-session-delete-confirm: Confirmation prompt shown before deleting a saved conversation.
mwassistant-chat-session-delete-error: Alert shown when deleting a saved conversation failed.
mwassistant-chat-loading-conversation: Placeholder shown in the chat log while a saved conversation loads.
mwassistant-chat-conversation-error: Shown in the chat log when a saved conversation could not be loaded.
mwassistant-chat-welcome: Welcome text shown in an empty chat log.
mwassistant-chat-input-placeholder: Placeholder text of the chat message input.
mwassistant-chat-send:
{{Identical|Send}}
Label of the button that sends a chat message.
mwassistant-chat-copy:
{{Identical|Copy}}
Label of the button that copies a code block to the clipboard.
mwassistant-chat-copy-code: Tooltip of the button that copies a code block to the clipboard.
mwassistant-chat-copied: Briefly shown on the copy button after the code was copied.
mwassistant-chat-copy-error:
{{Identical|Error}}
Briefly shown on the copy button when copying failed.
mwassistant-chat-thinking: Shown next to an animated indicator while waiting for the assistant.
mwassistant-chat-error:
Prefix for error messages shown in the chat log.

Parameters:
* $1 - the error description
mwassistant-chat-error-generic: Generic error shown in the chat log when no more specific message is available.
mwassistant-chat-error-unreachable: Error shown in the chat log when the request to the wiki failed.
mwassistant-chat-error-closed: Error shown when the response stream ended without an answer.
mwassistant-chat-error-too-large: Error shown when the response stream exceeded the client's size limit.
mwassistant-chat-error-malformed: Error shown when the server response could not be understood.
mwassistant-chat-tool-smw-ask: Heading of a tool-call block for a Semantic MediaWiki #ask query.
mwassistant-chat-tool-get-page: Heading of a tool-call block that reads a wiki page.
mwassistant-chat-tool-page-info: Heading of a tool-call block that fetches page metadata.
mwassistant-chat-tool-search-pages: Heading of a tool-call block for a keyword search.
mwassistant-chat-tool-find-pages-by-titl: Heading of a tool-call block that finds pages by title prefix.
mwassistant-chat-tool-vector-search: Heading of a tool-call block for a semantic (vector) search.
mwassistant-chat-tool-get-categories: Heading of a tool-call block that looks up categories.
mwassistant-chat-tool-get-properties: Heading of a tool-call block that looks up Semantic MediaWiki properties.
mwassistant-chat-tool-list-pages: Heading of a tool-call block that lists pages.
mwassistant-chat-tool-category-members: Heading of a tool-call block that lists the members of a category.
mwassistant-chat-tool-no-query: Shown instead of the query when a tool call has none.
mwassistant-chat-tool-unknown-page: Shown instead of the page title when a tool call has none.
mwassistant-chat-tool-checking:
Query summary of a category/property check.

Parameters:
* $1 - comma-separated list of names
mwassistant-chat-tool-search-prefix:
Query summary of a category/property prefix search.

Parameters:
* $1 - the prefix
mwassistant-chat-tool-list-all: Query summary of a category/property check without filters.
mwassistant-chat-tool-all: Query summary of a page listing without namespace or prefix.
mwassistant-chat-tool-running: Status shown on a tool-call block while the tool runs.
mwassistant-chat-tool-result: Label above the result of a tool call.
mwassistant-chat-tool-waiting: Placeholder for a tool result that has not arrived yet.
mwassistant-chat-tool-elapsed:
Time a tool call took.

Parameters:
* $1 - duration in milliseconds
mwassistant-chat-tool-no-matches: Shown as a tool result when the tool found nothing.
mwassistant-chat-tool-no-matches-short: Short summary of an empty tool result.
mwassistant-chat-tool-results-found:
Summary of a scored tool result.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of results
mwassistant-chat-tool-result-smw: Summary of a Semantic MediaWiki query result.
mwassistant-chat-tool-result-json: Summary of a tool result shown as raw JSON.
mwassistant-chat-tool-result-array: Summary of a tool result that is an unrecognised list.
mwassistant-chat-tool-result-object: Summary of a tool result that is an unrecognised object.
mwassistant-chat-tool-chars-total:
Shown after a truncated text tool result.

Parameters:
* $1 - total length of the result
mwassistant-chat-tool-truncated:
Notice on a tool result that hit the result limit.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of results shown
* $2 - the result limit
mwassistant-chat-tool-count:
Result count on a tool result.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of results
* $2 - the result limit
mwassistant-chat-tool-preview-truncated:
Short summary of a truncated tool result.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of results
* $2 - the result limit
mwassistant-chat-tool-preview-count:
Short summary of a tool result.

Parameters:
* $1 - number of results
mwassistant-chat-tool-suggestions: Label above suggested alternatives in a tool result.
mwassistant-chat-tool-score:
Relevance score of a search hit.

Parameters:
* $1 - the score
mwassistant-editor-button: Label of the editor toolbar button that opens the assistant sidebar.
mwassistant-editor-open-full-page: Tooltip and accessible label of the link from the editor sidebar to [[Special:MWAssistant]].
mwassistant-editor-close:
{{Identical|Close}}
Tooltip and accessible label of the button that closes the editor sidebar.
mwassistant-editor-chat-unavailable: Shown in the editor sidebar if the chat module failed to load.
mwassistant-chat-input-label:
{{Identical|Message}}
Accessible label of the chat message input.
mwassistant-chat-log-label: Accessible label of the chat log region.
mwassistant-chat-sessions-label: Accessible label of the list of saved conversations.
apierror-mwassistant-disabled: API error returned when $wgMWAssistantEnabled is false.
apierror-mwassistant-badparams: API error returned when an MWAssistant API request has invalid parameters. $1 = description of the problem (English, not localized).
apierror-mwassistant-user-mismatch: API error returned when the username/user_id parameters of an MWAssistant API request differ from the user named in the request's signed JWT.
apierror-mwassistant-smw-unavailable: API error returned by action=mwassistant-smw when the Semantic MediaWiki extension is not loaded.
mwassistant-smw-col-page:
Header of the first (result page) column in the HTML table returned by action=mwassistant-smw.
{{Identical|Page}}
mwassistant-smw-noresults: Text returned by action=mwassistant-smw in place of the result table when the query matched no readable pages.
mwassistantembeddings-total-vectors: Label of the stat card showing the total number of stored embedding vectors on [[Special:MWAssistantEmbeddings]].
mwassistantembeddings-namespace-status: Section heading above the per-namespace status table on [[Special:MWAssistantEmbeddings]].
mwassistantembeddings-col-total:
Column header: total number of pages in the namespace.
{{Identical|Total}}
mwassistantembeddings-col-synced: Column header and status pill label: pages whose embedding is up to date.
mwassistantembeddings-col-outdated: Column header and status pill label: pages whose embedding is older than the current revision.
mwassistantembeddings-col-skipped: Column header: pages skipped because their content is shorter than 10 characters.
mwassistantembeddings-col-missing: Column header and status pill label: pages that have no embedding.
mwassistantembeddings-col-action:
Column header for the per-namespace update button. Only shown to users who may queue updates.
{{Identical|Action}}
mwassistantembeddings-pill-skipped: Status pill label for skipped pages (see {{msg-mw|mwassistantembeddings-col-skipped}}).
mwassistantembeddings-update-button:
Button that queues embedding updates for every outdated page in a namespace.
{{Identical|Update}}
mwassistantembeddings-single-header: Section heading above the single-page update form.
mwassistantembeddings-single-label: Label for the page title input in the single-page update form.
mwassistantembeddings-single-button: Submit button of the single-page update form.
mwassistantembeddings-single-placeholder: Placeholder text of the page title input in the single-page update form.
mwassistantembeddings-page-not-found: Error shown when the page given in the single-page update form does not exist or cannot be read by the user (deliberately the same message for both). $1 = page title as entered.
mwassistantembeddings-invalid-namespace: Error shown when a batch update is requested for a namespace that is not listed for the user.
mwassistantembeddings-batch-failed: Error shown when queuing a batch update fails. $1 = error message (plain text).
mwassistantembeddings-queue-failed: Error shown when queuing a single-page update fails. $1 = error message (plain text).
mwassistantembeddings-stats-failed: Error shown when fetching embedding statistics from the MCP server throws. $1 = error message (plain text).
mwassistantembeddings-stats-error: Error shown when the MCP server returns an error for the statistics request. $1 = error message (plain text).
mwassistantembeddings-unknown-error:
Fallback for $1 of {{msg-mw|mwassistantembeddings-stats-error}} when the server gives no message.
{{Identical|Unknown error}}
